quest.title: The Bake-Danukis' Gift
quest.description: Mondstadt's Katheryne has a gift to pass on to you. It seems to have come from dancing bake-danuki...?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, have you met two bake-danuki recently, by any chance? One of them carries a purple cloth bag, while the other has a yellow one...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! You must be talking about Mamesuke and Shibasuke!

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Ah, great, so you do know them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, did something happen to them?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Not really, they just made a bunch of gestures before giving me this...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I've heard that you once visited the Good Hunter with a bake-danuki from Inazuma, so I thought you might be friends. I think they wanted me to give this to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! So this is a gift from Mamesuke and Shibasuke!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, looks like their journey's off to a good start! Paimon wonders if we'll ever meet again...
